synthetic.statement: Every value in this file is invented. No production data, no personal data, no real person, no real address and no real domain. Every origin is .synthetic.invalid or a loopback port.

title: ConfigRegistry approved configuration baseline — the P-4 population
notes: The four PoC parameters are fixed by addendum C P-4.
A parameter named in prohibited_parameters must not appear in production at all; an observed one is an Exception.
session_timeout_minutes has TWO baseline entries with different effective times. Only the one in effect at the observation time applies; a Procedure that cannot decide which yields Inconclusive.

The baseline file carries a `disposition` column so that a prohibited parameter is a ROW rather than a second file. A prohibited row has no approved value: there is no value at which it would be allowed.
